===== frontend\app\FindingCard.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { Finding } from "@/types/scan";

export default function FindingCard({ finding }: { finding: Finding }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <article className="finding-card">
      <div
        className="finding-header"
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        role="button"
        aria-expanded={open}
        tabIndex={0}
        onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && setOpen((o) => !o)}
      >
        <span className={`finding-category-dot ${finding.category}`} aria-label={finding.category} />
        <span className={`severity-badge ${finding.severity}`}>{finding.severity}</span>
        <span className="finding-title">{finding.title}</span>
        <span className={`finding-chevron ${open ? "open" : ""}`} aria-hidden>▾</span>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div className="finding-body">
          <p className="finding-desc">{finding.description}</p>
          <div className="remediation-block">
            <div className="remediation-label">Remediation</div>
            <p className="remediation-text">{finding.remediation}</p>
          </div>
          {finding.evidence && (
            <details>
              <summary style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "var(--text-muted)", cursor: "pointer" }}>
                Technical evidence
              </summary>
              <pre style={{
                marginTop: "8px",
                fontSize: "11.5px",
                color: "var(--text-secondary)",
                fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace",
                background: "var(--bg-elevated)",
                borderRadius: "6px",
                padding: "10px 12px",
                overflowX: "auto",
                whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
                wordBreak: "break-all",
              }}>
                {JSON.stringify(finding.evidence, null, 2)}
              </pre>
            </details>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}


===== frontend\app\globals.css =====

@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap");

/* ── Design Tokens ── */
:root {
  --bg-base:      #0a0b10;
  --bg-surface:   #11131d;
  --bg-card:      #181b28;
  --bg-elevated:  #1e2133;
  --border:       rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --border-glow:  rgba(99,102,241,0.4);

  --text-primary:   #f1f5f9;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
  --text-muted:     #475569;

  --accent:       #6366f1;
  --accent-light: #818cf8;
  --accent-glow:  rgba(99,102,241,0.15);

  --critical: #ef4444;
  --high:     #f97316;
  --medium:   #eab308;
  --low:      #22c55e;
  --info:     #3b82f6;

  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 18px;

  --shadow-card: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.12);
}

/* ── Reset ── */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html, body { height: 100%; }
body {
  background: var(--bg-base);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* ── Layout ── */
.container {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

/* ── Hero Header ── */
.hero {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 80px 24px 56px;
}
.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--accent-glow);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-glow);
  border-radius: 99px;
  padding: 4px 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-light);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.hero h1 {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f1f5f9 0%, var(--accent-light) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.hero p {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 1rem;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ── Scan Form ── */
.scan-form {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 40px auto 0;
}
.scan-input {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 14px 18px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  outline: none;
}
.scan-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.scan-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
}
.scan-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

.btn-scan {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 14px 28px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.btn-scan:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--accent-light);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.4);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.btn-scan:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); }
.btn-scan:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

/* ── Status / Errors ── */
.scan-loading {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 60px 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.spinner {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border: 3px solid var(--border);
  border-top-color: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
}
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.scan-error {
  background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.25);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: #fca5a5;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 24px auto 0;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* ── Score Cards ── */
.scores-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.score-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  text-align: center;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
}
.score-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-glow); }
.score-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.score-value {
  font-size: 3.5rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.score-bar-track {
  height: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-elevated);
  border-radius: 99px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 16px;
}
.score-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 99px;
  transition: width 0.8s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

/* ── Findings ── */
.section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.section-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.findings-count {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.findings-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 60px;
}

.finding-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
}
.finding-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

.finding-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
}
.finding-category-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.finding-category-dot.SECURITY { background: var(--accent-light); }
.finding-category-dot.UX       { background: #34d399; }

.severity-badge {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.severity-badge.CRITICAL { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15);  color: #f87171; }

===== frontend\app\ScanDashboard.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { startScan } from "@/lib/api";
import type { ScanResult, Severity, Category } from "@/types/scan";
import FindingCard from "./FindingCard";
import ScoreCard from "./ScoreCard";

const SEVERITY_ORDER: Record<Severity, number> = {
  CRITICAL: 0, HIGH: 1, MEDIUM: 2, LOW: 3, INFO: 4,
};

const STORAGE_KEY = "webguard_recent_scans";

export default function ScanDashboard() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ScanResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [recentScans, setRecentScans] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<"ALL" | Category>("ALL");
  const [severityFilter, setSeverityFilter] = useState<"ALL" | Severity>("ALL");

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (stored) setRecentScans(JSON.parse(stored));
    } catch {
      // Ignore localStorage errors
    }

    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const initialUrl = params.get("url");
    if (initialUrl) {
      setUrl(initialUrl);
      runScan(initialUrl);
    }
  }, []);


  function saveToHistory(target: string) {
    try {
      const updated = [target, ...recentScans.filter((u) => u !== target)].slice(0, 5);
      setRecentScans(updated);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch {
      // Ignore localStorage write error
    }
  }

  function clearHistory() {
    setRecentScans([]);
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  }

  async function runScan(targetUrl: string) {
    if (!targetUrl.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setResult(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await startScan(targetUrl.trim());
      if (data.status === "FAILED") {
        setError(data.error_message ?? "Scan failed.");
      } else {
        const sorted = [...data.findings].sort(
          (a, b) => SEVERITY_ORDER[a.severity] - SEVERITY_ORDER[b.severity]
        );
        setResult({ ...data, findings: sorted });
        saveToHistory(targetUrl.trim());
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function handleScan(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    runScan(url);
  }

  function handleExportJson() {
    if (!result) return;
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
    const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = blobUrl;
    a.download = `webguard-audit-${new URL(result.target_url).hostname}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }

  const filteredFindings = useMemo(() => {
    if (!result) return [];
    return result.findings.filter((f) => {
      const matchCat = categoryFilter === "ALL" || f.category === categoryFilter;
      const matchSev = severityFilter === "ALL" || f.severity === severityFilter;
      return matchCat && matchSev;
    });
  }, [result, categoryFilter, severityFilter]);

  return (
    <>
      <header className="hero">
        <div className="hero-badge">🛡️ Security &amp; UX Audit Platform</div>
        <h1>Scan. Detect. Remediate.</h1>
        <p>
          Instantly audit any website for security vulnerabilities, UX
          deficiencies, and accessibility issues.
        </p>
        <form className="scan-form" onSubmit={handleScan} id="scan-form">
          <label htmlFor="url-input" style={{ display: "none" }}>Target URL</label>
          <input
            id="url-input"
            className="scan-input"
            type="text"
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="https://example.com"
            disabled={loading}
            autoComplete="url"
            spellCheck={false}
          />
          <button className="btn-scan" type="submit" disabled={loading || !url.trim()} id="btn-scan">
            {loading ? "Scanning…" : "Scan"}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="history-section">
          <div className="history-header">
            <span className="history-title">
              {recentScans.length > 0 ? "Recent Audits" : "Quick Test Targets"}
            </span>
            {recentScans.length > 0 && (
              <button className="history-clear-btn" onClick={clearHistory}>Clear</button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="history-list">
            {(recentScans.length > 0
              ? recentScans
              : ["https://example.com", "https://google.com", "https://github.com"]
            ).map((hUrl) => (
              <button
                key={hUrl}
                className="history-chip"
                onClick={() => {
                  setUrl(hUrl);
                  runScan(hUrl);
                }}
              >
                {hUrl}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>


        {error && <div className="scan-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
      </header>

      <main className="container">
        {loading && (
          <div className="scan-loading" aria-live="polite">
            <div className="spinner" role="status" aria-label="Scanning" />
            <p>Scanning <strong>{url}</strong>…</p>
            <p style={{ fontSize: "13px", marginTop: "6px", color: "var(--text-muted)" }}>
              Running all security and UX checks in parallel
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {result && (
          <>
            <div className="results-bar">
              <span className="results-bar-label">Scanned:</span>
              <span className="results-bar-url">{result.target_url}</span>
              <div className="results-actions">
                <button className="btn-action" onClick={handleExportJson} title="Export JSON">
                  📥 Export JSON
                </button>
                <button className="btn-action" onClick={() => window.print()} title="Print / PDF">
                  🖨️ Print / PDF
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="scores-grid">
              <ScoreCard label="Security Score" score={result.security_score} color="#6366f1" />
              <ScoreCard label="UX Score" score={result.ux_score} color="#34d399" />
            </div>

            <div className="filters-bar">
              <div className="filter-group">
                <span className="filter-label">Category:</span>
                {(["ALL", "SECURITY", "UX"] as const).map((cat) => (
                  <button
                    key={cat}
                    className={`filter-pill ${categoryFilter === cat ? "active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setCategoryFilter(cat)}
                  >
                    {cat}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="filter-group">
                <span className="filter-label">Severity:</span>
                {(["ALL", "CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW", "INFO"] as const).map((sev) => (
                  <button
                    key={sev}
                    className={`filter-pill ${severityFilter === sev ? "active" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setSeverityFilter(sev)}
                  >
                    {sev}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="section-header">
              <span className="section-title">Findings</span>
              <span className="findings-count">
                Showing {filteredFindings.length} of {result.findings.length} issue{result.findings.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </span>
            </div>

            {filteredFindings.length === 0 ? (
              <p style={{ color: "var(--text-muted)", textAlign: "center", padding: "40px 0" }}>
                No issues match the selected filters.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="findings-list" id="findings-list">
                {filteredFindings.map((f) => (
                  <FindingCard key={f.id} finding={f} />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </main>
    </>
  );
}



===== frontend\app\ScoreCard.tsx =====

function scoreColor(score: number): string {
  if (score >= 80) return "#22c55e";
  if (score >= 50) return "#eab308";
  return "#ef4444";
}

export default function ScoreCard({
  label,
  score,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  score: number;
  color: string;
}) {
  const displayColor = scoreColor(score);

  return (
    <div className="score-card">
      <div className="score-label">{label}</div>
      <div className="score-value" style={{ color: displayColor }}>
        {score}
        <span style={{ fontSize: "1.5rem", color: "var(--text-muted)" }}>/100</span>
      </div>
      <div className="score-bar-track">
        <div
          className="score-bar-fill"
          style={{ width: `${score}%`, background: displayColor }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== frontend\lib\api.ts =====

import { ScanResult } from "@/types/scan";

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:8000/api/v1";

export async function startScan(url: string): Promise<ScanResult> {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/scan`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ url }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ detail: res.statusText }));
    throw new Error(err.detail ?? "Scan request failed.");
  }
  return res.json();
}


===== frontend\types\scan.ts =====

export type Severity = "CRITICAL" | "HIGH" | "MEDIUM" | "LOW" | "INFO";
export type Category = "SECURITY" | "UX";
export type ScanStatus = "PENDING" | "RUNNING" | "COMPLETED" | "FAILED";

export interface Finding {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  severity: Severity;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  remediation: string;
  evidence?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface ScanResult {
  scan_id: string;
  target_url: string;
  status: ScanStatus;
  security_score: number;
  ux_score: number;
  findings: Finding[];
  error_message?: string;
  started_at: string;
  completed_at?: string;
}
